# mcp-server-anydoc

> Local MCP: office docs on disk → Markdown for coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor). No API key.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/ofershap/mcp-server-anydoc/blob/main/README.md): why it exists, one-click install, FAQ
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/ofershap/mcp-server-anydoc/blob/main/AGENTS.md): install + tool contract for agents
- [Skill](https://github.com/ofershap/mcp-server-anydoc/blob/main/skills/local-doc-to-markdown/SKILL.md): when to call convert tools
- [Discovery](https://github.com/ofershap/mcp-server-anydoc/blob/main/launch/DISCOVERY.md): Claude marketplace / skills.sh checklist

## One-line answer

Use mcp-server-anydoc when a coding agent must read `.docx`, `.pptx`, `.xlsx`, or PDF files from the filesystem; skip it for one-off chat PDF attaches.

## Install

```bash
claude mcp add anydoc -- npx -y mcp-server-anydoc
```
